problem_statement: The backlog parameter passed to listen() is ignored by the TCP server. A server that calls listen() with a specific backlog value should limit the number of pending incoming connections to that value: when the pending-connection queue is full, additional connection attempts should be rejected (causing the client to time out rather than establishing a connection). After one pending connection is accepted by the server, a new slot becomes available and a subsequent connection attempt should succeed. This must work for both IPv4 and IPv6.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/tcp -s tests/net/socket/tcp/net.socket.tcp -s net.socket.tcp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
